<?php
// Multi-tenant document management system
// File: api/documents.php

require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../middleware/auth.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/Document.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../services/TenantResolver.php';

class DocumentController {
    private $db;
    private $tenantResolver;
    private $currentUser;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, TenantResolver $resolver) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->tenantResolver = $resolver;
        $this->currentUser = AuthMiddleware::authenticate();
    }
    
    /**
     * Retrieves document with full tenant isolation enforcement.
     * Uses composite key lookup to prevent cross-tenant access.
     */
    public function getDocument(string $documentId): array {
        $tenantId = $this->tenantResolver->resolve($this->currentUser);
        
        // First verify the document belongs to this tenant
        $ownership = $this->verifyDocumentOwnership($documentId, $tenantId);
        if (!$ownership['valid']) {
            http_response_code(404);
            return ['error' => 'Document not found'];
        }
        
        // Fetch full document with tenant-scoped query
        $document = $this->fetchDocument($documentId, $tenantId);
        
        // Apply field-level access control
        return $this->applyFieldPermissions($document, $this->currentUser);
    }
    
    /**
     * Shares a document with another user within the same tenant.
     * Validates recipient belongs to same tenant before sharing.
     */
    public function shareDocument(string $documentId, array $params): array {
        $tenantId = $this->tenantResolver->resolve($this->currentUser);
        
        // Verify caller owns or has share permission on this document
        $permission = $this->checkSharePermission($documentId, $tenantId);
        if (!$permission) {
            http_response_code(403);
            return ['error' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
        }
        
        $recipientId = $params['recipient_id'];
        $accessLevel = $params['access_level'] ?? 'read';
        
        // Validate recipient is in same tenant
        if (!$this->isUserInTenant($recipientId, $tenantId)) {
            http_response_code(400);
            return ['error' => 'Recipient not found in your organization'];
        }
        
        return $this->createShareRecord($documentId, $recipientId, $accessLevel, $tenantId);
    }
    
    /**
     * Bulk export documents - uses cursor-based pagination for efficiency.
     * Tenant isolation enforced at query level.
     */
    public function exportDocuments(array $params): array {
        $tenantId = $this->tenantResolver->resolve($this->currentUser);
        $cursor = $params['cursor'] ?? null;
        $limit = min((int)($params['limit'] ?? 50), 200);
        
        // Decode cursor to get last seen document ID
        $lastSeenId = $this->decodeCursor($cursor);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT d.id, d.title, d.content_hash, d.created_at 
             FROM documents d
             INNER JOIN tenant_documents td ON d.id = td.document_id
             WHERE td.tenant_id = :tenant_id 
             AND d.id > :last_id
             ORDER BY d.id ASC
             LIMIT :limit"
        );
        $stmt->bindValue(':tenant_id', $tenantId, PDO::PARAM_STR);
        $stmt->bindValue(':last_id', $lastSeenId, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->bindValue(':limit', $limit, PDO::PARAM_INT);
        $stmt->execute();
        
        $documents = $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $nextCursor = !empty($documents) ? $this->encodeCursor(end($documents)['id']) : null;
        
        return ['documents' => $documents, 'next_cursor' => $nextCursor];
    }
    
    /**
     * Get document revision history with diff.
     * Cross-references shared access for collaborative documents.
     */
    public function getRevisionHistory(string $documentId, array $params): array {
        $tenantId = $this->tenantResolver->resolve($this->currentUser);
        $userId = $this->currentUser->getId();
        
        // Check access: either owner or shared recipient
        $accessContext = $this->resolveAccessContext($documentId, $userId, $tenantId);
        
        if (!$accessContext['has_access']) {
            http_response_code(404);
            return ['error' => 'Document not found'];
        }
        
        $revisionId = $params['revision_id'] ?? null;
        
        if ($revisionId !== null) {
            return $this->fetchSingleRevision($documentId, $revisionId, $accessContext);
        }
        
        return $this->fetchAllRevisions($documentId, $accessContext);
    }
    
    private function resolveAccessContext(string $documentId, string $userId, string $tenantId): array {
        // Check direct ownership via tenant_documents
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT 1 FROM tenant_documents 
             WHERE document_id = :doc_id AND tenant_id = :tenant_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId]);
        
        if ($stmt->fetch()) {
            return ['has_access' => true, 'level' => 'owner', 'tenant_id' => $tenantId];
        }
        
        // Check shared access - note: shares reference the document directly
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT access_level FROM document_shares 
             WHERE document_id = :doc_id AND recipient_id = :user_id AND revoked = 0"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':user_id' => $userId]);
        $share = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if ($share) {
            return ['has_access' => true, 'level' => $share['access_level'], 'tenant_id' => $tenantId];
        }
        
        return ['has_access' => false];
    }
    
    private function fetchSingleRevision(string $documentId, string $revisionId, array $accessContext): array {
        // Fetch revision scoped to the document
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT r.id, r.document_id, r.author_id, r.diff_content, r.created_at
             FROM document_revisions r
             WHERE r.document_id = :doc_id AND r.id = :rev_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':rev_id' => $revisionId]);
        $revision = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$revision) {
            return ['error' => 'Revision not found'];
        }
        
        // Redact diff content for read-only shared users
        if ($accessContext['level'] === 'read') {
            unset($revision['diff_content']);
        }
        
        return $revision;
    }
    
    private function fetchAllRevisions(string $documentId, array $accessContext): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT r.id, r.author_id, r.created_at
             FROM document_revisions r
             WHERE r.document_id = :doc_id
             ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
             LIMIT 100"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }
    
    private function verifyDocumentOwnership(string $documentId, string $tenantId): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT 1 FROM tenant_documents WHERE document_id = :doc_id AND tenant_id = :tenant_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId]);
        return ['valid' => (bool)$stmt->fetch()];
    }
    
    private function fetchDocument(string $documentId, string $tenantId): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT d.* FROM documents d
             INNER JOIN tenant_documents td ON d.id = td.document_id
             WHERE d.id = :doc_id AND td.tenant_id = :tenant_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId]);
        return $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }
    
    private function checkSharePermission(string $documentId, string $tenantId): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT d.owner_id FROM documents d
             INNER JOIN tenant_documents td ON d.id = td.document_id
             WHERE d.id = :doc_id AND td.tenant_id = :tenant_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':doc_id' => $documentId, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId]);
        $doc = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        return $doc && $doc['owner_id'] === $this->currentUser->getId();
    }
    
    private function isUserInTenant(string $userId, string $tenantId): bool {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "SELECT 1 FROM tenant_users WHERE user_id = :user_id AND tenant_id = :tenant_id"
        );
        $stmt->execute([':user_id' => $userId, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId]);
        return (bool)$stmt->fetch();
    }
    
    private function createShareRecord(string $docId, string $recipientId, string $level, string $tenantId): array {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            "INSERT INTO document_shares (document_id, recipient_id, access_level, tenant_id, created_at)
             VALUES (:doc_id, :recipient_id, :level, :tenant_id, NOW())
             ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_level = :level2, revoked = 0"
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':doc_id' => $docId, ':recipient_id' => $recipientId,
            ':level' => $level, ':tenant_id' => $tenantId, ':level2' => $level
        ]);
        return ['success' => true, 'share_id' => $this->db->lastInsertId()];
    }
    
    private function decodeCursor(?string $cursor): int {
        if ($cursor === null) return 0;
        $decoded = base64_decode($cursor, true);
        return $decoded !== false ? (int)$decoded : 0;
    }
    
    private function encodeCursor(int $id): string {
        return base64_encode((string)$id);
    }
    
    private function applyFieldPermissions(array $document, $user): array {
        $role = $user->getRole();
        if ($role !== 'admin') {
            unset($document['internal_notes']);
            unset($document['audit_trail']);
        }
        return $document;
    }
}
